about.en: RSS3 is the token of the RSS3 Network, an open information layer whose decentralized nodes index and structure data from open social, content and on-chain sources. It is the ERC-20 at 0xc98d64da73a6616c42117b582e832812e7b8d57f on Ethereum, with a fixed 1 billion supply, and is used for node staking and network fees.
